title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities to take by eminent domain under Chapter 79, such rights of way, easements or other interests in land, or other property as may be necessary and have not been previously acquired, for the construction, operation, maintenance, alternation and removal of said natural gas transmission pipeline and appurtenant facilities situated in the Towns of Wales, Holland, Sturbridge and Charlton along the route of line 200-2 and in the Town of Methuen along the route of the Haverhill Lateral Line No. 2.
